findings.current: he had been confident he could bring down anyone who came for him.
findings.rationale: He believes no opponent can defeat him, not that he can defeat every opponent.
findings.replacement: he had been confident no one who came for him could bring him down.
findings.source: 그 누가 온다 해도 쓰러트릴 자신이 있었다.

findings.current: At the very least, he had to bring down the Imperial House, whose loathsome bloodline he had inherited, and this Great Nation, the achievement and legacy of Taizu.
findings.defect: Makes the Demon Lord the inheritor of the hated bloodline instead of the Imperial House.
findings.rationale: The Imperial House is the subject of 이어받은; the source does not say the Demon Lord inherited its blood.
findings.replacement: At the very least, he had to bring down the Imperial House, heir to that loathsome bloodline, and this Great Nation, Taizu’s achievement and legacy.
findings.source: 증오스러운 피를 이어받은 황실과, 태조의 업적이자 유산인 이 대국을 허물어트려야 했다.

findings.defect: Changes the fist’s overwhelming impact into a deflection.
findings.rationale: 휩쓸었다 overturns the preceding description of merely meeting the opposing fist; the following injury shows the attack carrying through, not pushing the fist aside.
findings.replacement:
No.

It swept right through it.

findings.current: His legs, driven into the ground with the force of a thousand tons, scraped deep furrows as they slid backward.
findings.defect: Inflates ten thousand geun to a thousand tons.
findings.rationale: 만근 is ten thousand geun, approximately six metric tons, not a thousand tons.
findings.replacement: His legs, planted in the ground with roughly six tons of force, carved deep furrows as they were driven backward.
findings.source: 만근의 힘으로 지면에 틀어박힌 두 다리가 깊은 고랑을 만들어 내며 밀려났다.

findings.current: But then he felt a force of a thousand tons seize his ankle as he kicked off the ground with all his strength.
findings.defect: Again inflates ten thousand geun to a thousand tons.
findings.rationale: 만근거력 specifies a force of ten thousand geun.
findings.replacement: But as he kicked off the ground with all his strength, he felt a force of roughly six tons seize his ankle.
findings.source: 그리고 온 힘을 다해 땅을 박차며 나아가는 그의 발목을 잡아채는, 만근거력(萬斤巨力)을 느꼈다.

findings.current: The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s upper body had already been scorched black by the previous attack. He didn’t resist the force throwing him backward.
findings.defect: Extends the scorching from half his upper body to all of it.
findings.rationale: 상반신의 절반 specifies half of his upper body.
findings.replacement: Half the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s upper body had been scorched black by the previous attack. He didn’t resist the force throwing him backward.
findings.source: 앞서의 공격으로 상반신의 절반이 새카맣게 그을린 동천마군은 튕겨 나가는 힘을 거스르지 않았다.

findings.current:
More than half a century had passed.

He had watched countless Supreme Peak masters from the shadows of the Imperial Palace.
findings.defect: Detaches the duration from his activity in the Imperial Palace.
findings.rationale: The source says he spent that long operating covertly in the palace and seeing those masters.
findings.replacement: For well over half a century, he had operated in the shadows of the Imperial Palace and observed countless Supreme Peak masters.
findings.source:
장장 반백 년을 훌쩍 넘어서는 긴 세월.

황궁에서 암약하며 수많은 초절정 고수를 보았다.

summary: The draft reverses two consequential statements and changes a combat action. It also overstates a force measurement and omits an injury detail.
